convective_fluxes.notes: Subsonic and smooth: no limiter (minmod stalls viscous convergence, see c12).

implicit.notes: max_relative_update 0.2: at 15 deg / 449x129 unlimited accepted steps built an odd-even checkerboard in nu~ and rho (nu_hat -1648 / +1593, rho 0.37-7.4 on one wall-normal line at x = 0.69) within 600 steps, after which every step was rejected.

convergence.notes: 6000: at 449x129 / 10 deg the residual rose for ~1500 steps from the freestream start (peak 7e-3) before falling ~1 order per 250 steps; 3000 ended at 7.3 orders with CL still moving 2e-3.
